name: Wayta
description: Wayta is a human warrior of the Sun Empire on Ixalan who lost her left eye in the New Phyrexian Invasion and admires Huatli.

description_citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
description_citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

summary.text: Wayta is a human warrior of the Sun Empire on Ixalan who lost her left eye in the New Phyrexian Invasion and admires Huatli.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

bio.text: As a thirteen-year-old she met her idol Huatli, who advised her that poetry should be honest rather than merely good.

citations.text: "Wayta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

bio.text: At the outbreak of the invasion she lied about her age to join the Sun Empire forces and lost her left eye at Tocatli.

citations.text: "Wayta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She then joined the Brazen Coalition for a year, befriended Malcolm Lee, and returned home through faith in the Threefold Sun.

citations.text: "Wayta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She guided Quint to Orazca and joined Huatli's expedition into the caverns, where she solved the glyph-bridge riddle.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

bio.text: She fought the fungal titan, was shoved into the river by the River Heralds, and argued with Quint about who should tell Ixalan's stories.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

bio.text: She fought Aclazotz and the vampire bat-demons alongside the Oltec and later received Inti's sword from Huatli.

citations.text: "Wayta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

status.text: Wayta is alive and a member of Huatli's Sun Empire party, having just received Inti's sword and an invitation to Otepec.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli advises the young Wayta that poetry should be honest rather than merely good.
timeline.quote: Try to make it honest .

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Wayta calls off the dinosaurs, rescuing Quint, and introduces herself.
timeline.quote: With the flick of a hand, she dismissed the others as if they were trained pets, and they disappeared into the jungle.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta leads Quint to a view of the golden city of Orazca.
timeline.quote: saw the full, blinding brilliance of the golden city in the valley below

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli finishes translating the tablets' poem about the Komon and the imprisoned god Chimil.
timeline.quote: The translation was finished.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Beyond the door, Huatli's party finds glowing, linen-wrapped warrior corpses and the armored remains of a massive horned creature.
timeline.quote: The remains of a massive humanoid creature dominated the opposite corner of the room

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Wayta recalls fighting the Phyrexian invasion, sailing with the Brazen Coalition and finally returning to the Sun Empire to join Huatli's expedition.
timeline.quote: She'd left the pirates and returned to the Sun Empire a year older

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The expedition finds a chasm of glowing green fog crossed by glyph-marked stones.
timeline.quote: Caparocti dropped a pebble into the fog.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta deduces the stone path from the poem and sets out across the chasm.
timeline.quote: Let me try, Warrior-Poet.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta steps on a wrong stone, it falls, and the platforms begin to rearrange.
timeline.quote: Without warning, it fell into the fog.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caparocti hauls Wayta to safety and crosses with her.
timeline.quote: Strong hands grabbed her arms and hauled her up.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta touches the glyph panel in the poem's order, and the platforms form a solid bridge.
timeline.quote: The platforms slid together, forming a solid bridge, much easier to cross.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caparocti tells Wayta he is sure war with the Dusk Legion is coming and that the colonizers must be eliminated.
timeline.quote: The colonizers must be eliminated, or they will never stop trying to rule us.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint beholds a huge underground fungus-covered stone city, reminiscent of Zantafar.
timeline.quote: Before him stretched a cavern many miles across, from edge to edge filled with stone buildings and narrow streets.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint finds a purple-pink poncho and beads in a plaza and uses the spell The Rousing on it.
timeline.quote: Quint finally found a pile of cloth and beads, surprisingly well preserved.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The spell summons the ghost of an old man who has forgotten his name.
timeline.quote: The poncho rose, hovering in the air.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The ghost cries that it must warn Oteclan of a mycoid infestation and that the door must be closed, then runs off.
timeline.quote: I must warn Oteclan of the mycoid infestation. It's too late. The door must be closed!

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Abuelo cries 'Titan!' and vanishes as Wayta and Quint chase him by an underground river.
timeline.quote: then vanished in a swirl of purple-pink energy

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A huge mushroom-headed titan appears and charges Wayta and Quint.
timeline.quote: Ahead, a hulking figure loomed, easily twice her height.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The titan hurls a chunk of wall at Wayta, who dodges and fights it alone.
timeline.quote: The titan grabbed half of a crumbling wall and threw it at Wayta.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The titan heals its wounds with fungus, kills warriors and spits corrosive black fluid; one warrior dies despite Wayta's attempt to help.
timeline.quote: the sight of bloody bone through the remains of the man's flesh told her she was too late.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A dozen smaller mushroom creatures surround the Sun Empire party.
timeline.quote: A dozen new creatures surrounded them

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: River Heralds burst out of the river and join the battle, offering to take the party to safety.
timeline.quote: A wave lashed out of the underground river, knocking two of the creatures away.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A Herald casts a breathing spell on Wayta and shoves her into the river.
timeline.quote: Swift travels, little sister

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta surfaces in an underground freshwater sea beside Quint.
timeline.quote: Wayta kicked her way to the surface, searching for the others

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Nicanzil welcomes the party to the River Heralds' city.
timeline.quote: I am Nicanzil

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta objects to Quint's plan to excavate and write up Ixalan's history for outsiders.
timeline.quote: You shouldn't be telling our stories for us.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire party reaches the top of the building facing the golden door and meets the vampires, provoking hostility.
timeline.quote: The other warriors mirrored her disgust, some reaching for weapons.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Beyond the door, the party reaches a well-like opening showing a circle of sky deep underground.
timeline.quote: They stood before a circle of sky dotted with clouds.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal Pakal receives the Sun Empire group and raises the presence of vampires.
timeline.quote: I have heard some of your story from my sister Anim

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Abuelo tells Quint the khipu was Abuela's and Quint proposes bringing her back as an Echo.
timeline.quote: Perhaps we can bring her back, as I helped you come back.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint watches Sun Empire warriors and Oltec riders prepare for a coming-of-age flight.
timeline.quote: He watched the Sun Empire warriors don special harnesses, supervised by members of the Thousand Moons.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The bat riders fly toward the cosmium reef to claim cosmium.
timeline.quote: Huatli and the others would try to claim a piece of that cosmium for themselves.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta reports that the vampires have summoned a bigger cloud of cursed fog.
timeline.quote: The vampires have summoned a cloud of their cursed fog, bigger than usual.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta panics at the darkening sun and is reminded of the Phyrexian war.
timeline.quote: The sun darkened, and Wayta fought the urge to panic, cold sweat pooling in the small of her back.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta sees Aclazotz and the transformed vampires fly to the cosmium reef.
timeline.quote: led by a bat as large as three or four people standing end to end: Aclazotz.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Chara warns that Chimil's prison is being remade.
timeline.quote: We must stop the betrayer Aclazotz, or Chimil will be sealed inside again.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and Oltec rally with Huatli's poem and cry 'For the Threefold Sun!'
timeline.quote: For the Threefold Sun!

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The vampire abominations attack the Oltec bat riders and the great battle begins.
timeline.quote: The vampire abominations flew toward the Oltec force.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta wounds a vampire-bat in air combat.
timeline.quote: Her blade tore a deep gash in her enemy's wing, and with a scream, he spun toward the earth.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta sees a siren fleeing from the door and a flood of fungal creatures behind him.
timeline.quote: A rush of greenish blackness poured through the portal behind him.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta meet in the air and exchange news of the mushroom horde and the bat monsters.
timeline.quote: The vampires have transformed into bat monsters and their god imprisoned the sun.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta spots a temple of Aclazotz revealed in a sheared mountain face.
timeline.quote: Pillars of a great temple rose from the sheared mountain face.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint casts an eavesdropping spell so Wayta can hear the talks.
timeline.quote: Pulling a scroll from his pack, Quint cleared his throat.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Caparocti argue over invading Torrezon and Huatli warns him off.
timeline.quote: And yet your title was stolen for you by your cousin Inti rather than granted by the late emperor.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli gives Inti's cosmium-pommeled sword to Wayta, saying his Echo is in the gem.
timeline.quote: He's an Echo now. His spirit is here, in the gem.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli announces an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.
timeline.quote: I've received an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli asks Quint's help on Ixalan, where he helps Huatli open the caverns and reanimates Abuelo's spirit before mycoids attack.
timeline.quote: Quint used his magic to reanimate the spirit of a man named Abuelo

citation.work: Quintorius
citation.text: "Quintorius", section "On Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: the warriors battled Aclazotz
